title: The Ticket
description: Eric examines the ticket while Tappy tries to make sense of it. Something is written on the back.
transcript: A ticket? I don’t remember taking it. It’s just... there, folded against me, as if it’s been waiting.
Indoors, lights, loud music, and now a ticket. That’s either a festival with a very confused postcode, or someone’s leaving breadcrumbs with a strong beat.
Tappy leans closer to the ticket, squinting at it.
I can’t read it from here.
There’s something written on the back.
Right then. I’ll nudge it over with the front of me and give it a proper look. If it’s a clue, it’s been keeping it from us out of principle.
